messages:
maria: Power flicked out during a deploy so I improvised a pop-up office in the garage. car battery UPS + camping lantern + 4G travel router = surprisingly productive. photos later.
jamal: Garage pop-up? that sounds like a music video. pics pls :camera_with_flash:
maria: uploading two: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F99999/garage-wide.jpg and https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F99998/trunk-setup.jpg (note: duct tape aesthetic)
sophie: This is delightfully chaotic. how's the connection? can you ship a tiny ethernet from trunk to desk?
maria: tethered router in trunk via 15ft ethernet. latency ~115ms to west coast, bandwidth around 6/3 Mbps. stable for calls if I mute video.
ravi: If you want lower jitter, try `ssh -C -o Compression=no -D1080 me@jumpbox` and proxy traffic through the jumpbox, reduces chattiness on the mobile link. also bump your MTU down if the carrier fragments packets.
maria: good tip, did `ssh -D1080` and felt fewer hiccups during standup. saved the session in `~/.garage_jump` for next time.
leo: neighbor kid's drone kept circling the lantern and startled the cat. logistics: secure the lantern or bring the cat inside :scream_cat:
jamal: also vote: WFH emergency kit doc? categories: power, network, lighting, pet management. thumbs up/down
sophie: thumbs up from me. add a "duct tape is a feature" subsection. :laughing:
infra-bot: Reminder: please avoid connecting personal network devices directly to corporate VLANs. Reach out to infra for a short-lived approved VPN endpoint if doing critical work on personal hotspots.
maria: noted infra-bot, didn't bridge anything to corp VLAN. just SSH and API work from laptop.
leo: 100% we need a gallery of "creative WFH setups" for the random channel. this is top tier content.
maria: i'll throw together a 1-pager with pics and a short checklist: "Bring: phone charger, spare battery, zip ties, duct tape, lantern, ethernet, patience"
jamal: add: snacks. energy is important. :yum:
maria: absolutely. snacks and patience. end-of-thread photo: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F99997/trunk-router-closeup.jpg
